test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is__** born**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word born means **to come into this world by birth.**
 
• *Example *: I was **born **in a rich family.
 
• The **meaning **of above sentence is that Mahalia Jackson come into this world and she got birth in a preacher's family in 1911.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Adorn** means to add something to make something or someone more appealing or beautiful

*Example *: My mother *adorned *me with thousands of jewels.

 
• The word **worn **means as a result of extensive use, damaged and shabby

*Example *: He was wearing **worn **out clothes.

 
• The word **Scorn **means the strong feeling you get when you don't respect someone or something 

*Example *: The President **scorned **his detractors.
